coordinate_reference_systems.geodetic: EPSG:4979 (latitude, longitude, height above the ellipsoid)

notes: Values are decimal strings carrying more digits than float64 holds so the fixture stays usable if the tolerance is tightened.
The NED to ECEF rotation depends on latitude and longitude only; altitude does not enter it.

Point selection covers the equator and prime meridian, both poles, the antimeridian from both signs, negative and high altitude, negative zero altitude, and asymmetric points that fail if latitude and longitude are swapped.
